disciplinary_grounds.description: Recommending a particular attorney to handle a case in which the bail bond agent caused a bond to be issued.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Recommending any particular attorney at law to handle the case in which the bail bond agent has caused a bond to be issued under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forging the name of another to a bond or application for bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Forging the name of another to a bond or application for bond.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting business in or about any place where prisoners or persons in custody are held.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting business in or about any place for prisoners or persons confined, arraigned, or in custody.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying fees, rebates, or giving anything of value to law enforcement or public officials to secure a settlement or advantage on a bail bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying a fee or rebate, or giving or promising anything of value to a jailer, trustee, police officer or officer of the law, or any other person who has power to arrest or hold in custody or to any public official or public employee in order to secure a settlement, compromise, remission, or reduction of the amount of any bail bond or entreatment thereof, or to secure, delay, or other advantage.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying fees, rebates, or giving anything of value to an attorney in bail bond matters (except in defense of an action on a bond).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying a fee or rebating or giving anything of value to an attorney in bail bond matters, except in defense of any action on a bond.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting anything of value from a principal other than a premium or permissible collateral.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting anything of value from a principal other than a premium.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to return collateral security to the principal when entitled.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to return collateral security to the principal when the principal is entitled to the security.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly employing a person whose insurance producer license has been revoked, suspended, or denied.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly employing a person whose insurance producer license has been revoked, suspended, or denied in this or any other state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or intentionally executing a bail bond without collecting in full a premium at the filed and approved rate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or intentionally executing a bail bond without collecting in full a premium for the bond, at the premium rate as filed with and approved by the commissioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay any forfeiture as directed by a court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay any forfeiture as directed by a court and as required by this chapter.

premium_rate_percentage.value: maximum twenty percent of the amount of bail, or one hundred fifty dollars, whichever is greater
premium_rate_percentage.quote: A bail bond agent may not charge a premium, commission, or fee for a bond in an amount more than twenty percent of the amount of bail furnished by the bail bond agent, or one hundred fifty dollars, whichever is greater.

minimum_premium_amount.quote: or one hundred fifty dollars, whichever is greater

collateral_receipt_required.quote: When a bail bond agent accepts collateral, the bail bond agent shall give a written receipt for the collateral and this receipt must contain a full description of the collateral received in the terms of redemption.

attorney_referral_prohibited.quote: Recommending any particular attorney at law to handle the case in which the bail bond agent has caused a bond to be issued under this chapter.

rebate_and_kickback_prohibition.quote: Paying a fee or rebate, or giving or promising anything of value to a jailer, trustee, police officer or officer of the law, or any other person who has power to arrest or hold in custody or to any public official or public employee in order to secure a settlement, compromise, remission, or reduction of the amount of any bail bond

law_enforcement_prohibited_from_acting_a.quote: The following persons or classes may not be bail bond agents and may not directly or indirectly receive any benefits from the execution of any bail bond: jailers, police officers, committing magistrates, magistrate court judges, sheriffs, deputy sheriffs and constables, or any person having the power to arrest or having anything to do with the control of federal, state, county, or municipal prisoners.

surrender_of_principal_rules.quote: At any time before there has been a breach of the undertaking in any type of bail provided herein, the surety or bail bond agent may surrender the defendant, or the defendant may surrender, to the official to whose custody the defendant would have been given had the defendant been committed.

forfeiture_notice_and_reinstatement_dead.quote: If the bail bond agent returns the defendant to the jurisdiction of the court within six months of receiving notice of the failure to appear, the court shall return at least fifty percent of the forfeiture upon petition by the bail bond agent.

bond_register_required.quote: The bail bond agent shall keep copies of all receipts of the bonds to be placed in business to be available to the commissioner for the commissioner's review.

bail_bond_agency_license_separate_from_a.quote: A bail bond agent or bail bond agency may not advertise as or hold itself out to be a surety company.

bondsman_access_to_court_records.quote: Every person who holds a valid bail bond agent license issued by the insurance commissioner is entitled to equal access to the jails of the state for the purpose of making bond
